description: Baseline snapshot of pre-existing check-then-mutate sites. All targeted tables are RLS-protected and each mutation is separately gated by has_permission on the same module.action pair via row-level policies. New sites MUST refactor to a SECURITY DEFINER RPC that fuses the permission check and mutation; adding entries to this baseline for new code is prohibited by code review.
